name: amer
description: Easy, safe team git workflow: /amer <task> (agent does the task and ships it end to end), /amer-start (sync with team), /amer-save (clean commit + version bump), /amer-check (pre-flight tests), /amer-ship (push + pull request), /amer-status, /amer-undo, /amer-setup, /amer-help.
